description: A bearded man with a gold laurel wreath and a dark cloak stands at a stone altar, sprinkling or offering something from his hands over a bowl. Smoke and flames rise from a brazier at the right. Behind him are large marble statues of a bearded god and a helmeted goddess holding a spear, and a torch burns on the left beside a relief-carved column. The scene is dim and lit by firelight, with no visible text, frame or border.
